$comment: Where a second pack may appear on this app, and why. A pack boundary re-points
a region's colour and its corner radius, so every region that carries one has
to be a decision rather than a drift.
The Board is one ground. It wears lavender, dark by default, on the document
element, and nothing beneath it carries a second pack: there is no product mark,
no pack switcher and no scoped region in the walking skeleton. The map is
therefore an empty, explicit set — 'a map that says zero is a decision' — so the
gate holds this app to it the day a boundary appears.
